_about: EV-016 live acceptance query set for plan kensaku-v1-1 (REQ-008 as amended, D-034). Q1-Q6 are the MVP queries, unchanged, so results are comparable with EV-008 run 1. Q7 (specific model) and Q8 (open-ended, budget in SGD) add Singapore coverage; Q8's text is the spike's V1 question. Run only through the live acceptance command within the budget below. The owner approves this set with plan kensaku-v1-1.

budget.planTotal: The plan-wide cap governs over the per-run caps: across the JM-104 smoke and every EV-016 run, at most 130 Exa requests and $1.50 of reported cost. The suite reads the committed run logs and the smoke log before starting and refuses to start a query whose worst case (5 requests) would exceed the remaining requests, or once the remaining reported-cost allowance is below $0.05.

runRules: Each suite run starts with an empty Exa cache and an empty image cache, so every run makes fresh Exa calls and fresh image fetches.
Every suite run's log is committed under .futari/evidence/live/, including failed and blocked runs.

A second or third run is allowed only after a recorded fix (commit SHA and reason in .futari/evidence/JM-106.md) or after a run recorded as BLOCKED by an Exa outage. The verdict comes from the last run; best-of-N selection is not allowed.
The MVP command pnpm live:acceptance (EV-008) is history and must not be run during v1.1 execution; JM-106 removes its package.json script.

Revalidation is a self-consistency check: each displayed offer is reclassified from the recorded Exa response and must equal what the UI showed, and each displayed image is re-derived from the recorded Exa response (rules I1 and I2) and the recorded fetch result (rule I3). It detects display or pipeline mutation, not extraction errors; the owner audit covers those.
The suite drives the built app in a real browser (Playwright, Chromium) so that image loading and network requests are observed as a user would see them.

thresholds.displayedOffersPassingOwnerAudit: at least 90% of all displayed offers across the run (main and Other markets lists), each audited by the owner as the right product on a direct merchant page; failures allowed = floor(10% of displayed offers)
thresholds.productsWithAnOfferShowingAProductImage: at least 70% of product cards that list at least one merchant offer show a loaded product image (not the fallback)
thresholds.displayedImagesPassingOwnerAudit: each displayed image is audited by the owner with the image rubric; failures allowed = max(1, floor(10% of displayed images))

auditRubric: Right product: the merchant page sells the candidate model (a colour variant counts; a different model or a bundle does not).
Direct merchant: the URL is the merchant's own product page, not a review, aggregator, marketplace, search, or category page.
Price display: the shown price, currency, and availability equal the values Exa returned for that URL in this run, as recorded in the run log.
imageAuditRubric: Right product: the image shows the card's product model (any colour or variant counts when the caption names the source page's product title; a different model, a bundle shot that hides the product, a logo, a banner, a placeholder, or a lifestyle photo where the product is not the subject does not).
Attributed: the caption names the host of the page the image came from, and that page is one of the card's merchant offers or the manufacturer's page.
